built_from: a trace build of a scratch copy of the worktree (_scratch/ui-trace-b24-ui/dist) + src/i18n/ui.ts + src/lib/categories.ts + the inline sites listed in tools/lib/inline-sites.mjs + ur-translation/memory/tm.json
source_rule: English is the translation source. Arabic is the authority where the two diverge on a fact, and the ONLY source of name spellings. Arabic-only content is not imported. precedent = the approved ru / de / zh values of the same string: reference, never source.
scope_rule: A string is in the batch because a built page shows it, not because a dictionary lists it. tier "rendered" = on the /ur/ page(s) /ur/events/kafu-nights/. tier "detail-template" = not on the calibration detail page, but rendered by the same detail template on attraction pages of batches b1 / b2 (measured on a trace build that gave those ten pages a placeholder title). tier "other-language-pages" = in the language-suggestion bar that other languages' pages show a visitor whose browser asks for Urdu — it appears once /ur/ pages are listed (measured on a trace build with the three pages listed). Every other ui.ts key renders only on pages that have no /ur/ version yet and is listed under later_rounds.
stage_file_shape: stage files carry strings = { "<id>": "<Urdu>" } with exactly the ids of this pack's strings, in this order. See tools/README.md.
placeholder_rule: A placeholder listed for a string ({op}, {n}) is kept exactly once, untouched. det.openMaps keeps its trailing space + U+2197. Digits that stand in the English stay Latin digits.

header_budget.rule: Navigation labels are bound by measurement, not by taste (CLAUDE.md: the header is measured, never estimated). After any change to a navigation label, tools/measure-header-fit.mjs must pass; it requires no overlap, ONE row and a header height of exactly 68px.

facts.measured: 2026-10-12, worktree dist at fce37cf (feat/ur-round-1), headless Chrome via tools/measure-header-fit.mjs (MODE=fit and verify) and a per-link probe

header_budget.what_the_labels_must_fit: With the present [lang="ur"] block in Header.astro the bar is shown from a 1518px window and is collapsed into the burger below it (so on 1280-1536px laptop screens the Urdu header is the burger menu, whatever the labels). For that threshold to stay valid the bar may need at most 1478px: brand 71.6 + nav + actions + 2 x 16 gap, i.e. nav (ten labels and nine 10px gaps) plus actions (search button, saved-places link with its counter, language button, gold button) of at most 1374.4px — today 1373.6px with the English labels in a Latin face at 13.5px. The Urdu labels will be set in the Nastaliq face, which is wider and taller: the widths below are the English ones and are a reference, not a prediction. If the Urdu labels need more, the thresholds of the [lang="ur"] block are re-measured and moved (an engineering step for the coordinator), or shorter labels are chosen — measured either way.

ev.kafu-nights.intro.en: Kafu Nights is an annual Ramadan community festival organised by King Faisal University in Al-Ahsa Governorate; its first edition was held in 2024. “Kafu” comes from an Arabic verb meaning “to be rewarded”: to earn reward and praise. Among the highlights of the nights is the “Ghabqa”, a popular meal and social custom held on the nights of the holy month of Ramadan in the Arab Gulf states.
ev.kafu-nights.intro.ar: مهرجان «ليالي كفو» هو مهرجان رمضاني ومجتمعي سنوي تُنظمه جامعة الملك فيصل في محافظة الأحساء، وكانت أول نسخة منه سنة 2024.

precedent.ru: Слово «Кафу» происходит от арабского глагола со значением «быть вознаграждённым», то есть заслужить награду и похвалу. Среди ключевых моментов этих ночей — «Габка», народная трапеза и общественный обычай: её устраивают ночами священного месяца Рамадан в арабских странах Залива.
precedent.de: „Kafu“ geht auf ein arabisches Verb zurück, das „belohnt werden“ bedeutet: Lohn und Lob ernten. Zu den Höhepunkten der Kafu-Nächte gehört die „Ghabqa“, eine volkstümliche Mahlzeit und gesellschaftliche Sitte, die in den Nächten des heiligen Monats Ramadan in den arabischen Ländern der Golfregion gepflegt wird.
precedent.zh: “卡夫”（Kafu）一词源自阿拉伯语动词，意为“受到奖赏”，即赢得奖赏与赞誉。卡夫之夜的亮点活动之一是“盖布加”晚宴。“盖布加”是海湾阿拉伯国家的一种民间聚餐与社交习俗，在神圣斋月的夜晚举行。

ev.kafu-nights.intro.note: Opening paragraph of the season page.
ev.kafu-nights.intro.approved_today: “کفو” عربی کے ایک فعل سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے “صلہ پانا”، یعنی انعام اور تعریف حاصل کرنا۔ ان راتوں کی نمایاں سرگرمیوں میں “غبقہ” بھی شامل ہے۔ یہ خلیجی عرب ممالک میں رمضان المبارک کی راتوں کا ایک مقبول کھانا اور سماجی رسم ہے۔
ev.kafu-nights.intro.reopened_by: owner decided 2026-10-17 (after #186, readers in five languages asked what the event IS): the source intro gained a FIRST sentence defining the event (en "Kafu Nights is an annual Ramadan community festival organised by King Faisal University in Al-Ahsa Governorate; its first edition was held in 2024." / ar, now the whole intro of the Arabic page: "مهرجان «ليالي كفو» هو مهرجان رمضاني ومجتمعي سنوي تُنظمه جامعة الملك فيصل في محافظة الأحساء، وكانت أول نسخة منه سنة 2024."). Add that sentence first; the approved rest (the meaning of Kafu and the Ghabqa) stays.
